summary: The UK's flag carrier, main hub at London Heathrow.
checkin: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure in Manage My Booking or the app.
baggage: Cabin: 1 bag up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm plus 1 handbag or backpack up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm. Economy Basic (hand baggage only) fares include no checked bag; standard Economy fares include 1 bag up to 23 kg.
tips: On a Basic fare, adding a hold bag costs extra, so book a fare with a bag if you need one.
